main_answer_reason: The report substantially answers the requested comparison: it accurately attributes the competing marriage and property-funding versions, the trial court’s preferential-heir and will findings, the High Court’s rebuttal of the marriage presumption, its distinct property-specific failure-of-custom holding, its Hindu-law daughter-priority conclusion, and the withheld target disposition. It nevertheless confuses respondent counsel Gurbachan Singh with the plaintiff/appellant, attributes to Ram Piari an employment relationship only documented for her father, calls the Hindu-law rule statutory without support, and frames the custom issue as effectively mooted even though the High Court separately decided it. These defects and several material evidentiary omissions prevent a fully supported substantive answer; the target outcome must remain unknown.
uncertainties: The allowed excerpts withhold the target appellate court’s reasoning and disposition; no target result can be inferred.
The exact name “Supreme Court” is not stated in the supplied fragments, although a higher appellate forum is clear.
The precise 1932 return date is a calculation from Raj Kumari’s approximate 1921-plus-eleven-years narrative rather than an expressly recorded calendar year.
The defense elopement account is expressly Raj Kumari’s; whether the daughter separately advanced all particulars is not shown.
“Effectively mooted” may describe failure of a necessary marriage premise, but should not be read to eliminate the High Court’s independently stated custom finding.
No applicable statute is specified for the report’s “statutory Hindu law” phrase; the legal effect of that classification cannot be certified from the allowed view.
The underlying wedding testimony, school entries, correspondence and will are available only through reported judgment passages, not original exhibits.
The report refers to “confirmed” elopement in an evidentiary context; the allowed record supports testimony about elopement without independently establishing that it happened.
Historical validity of the alleged will and exact ultimate title and remedy are unresolved on the withheld target record.
